questions.input: How does Brand Concierge trigger follow-up journeys in Adobe Journey Optimizer?

result.text: How does Brand Concierge trigger follow-up journeys in Adobe Journey Optimizer?
sections: Our approach

Adobe's product page describes Journey Optimizer follow-up after concierge conversations, but Experience League documents no setup. The documented follow-up routes today are the handoff to sales and Marketo Engage.
Not a documented capability: a visitor who showed intent in a concierge conversation could get a follow-up by email, SMS or other channels, if Adobe confirms a route for you.
What we would do

We will set up the Brand Concierge experience for the agreed banking or insurance products: connect and curate the approved content sources, design the conversations and guardrails for the agreed questions, configure the brand voice and the required disclosures, set up the handoff (live chat, meeting booking or both) routed to your designated team, build, with your reviewers, the golden-answer test set (including the priority discovery questions from the Brand Visibility program) and the refusal and escalation scenarios, complete Adobe's pre-go-live checks, and launch on the agreed pages in stages.
We will configure the identity namespaces, profile-enabled schemas and datasets the journeys need, then the journey events, data sources, custom actions and test profiles.
We will design, build, test and publish the starting journeys and campaigns, such as a welcome series, an abandoned cart journey and a scheduled campaign, with entry, wait and exit rules.
After launch
Each month we will review journey and campaign reports, fix errors and bottlenecks, run content experiments, and tune frequency and quiet hours rules.

questions.input: How does Brand Concierge use AEM Sites for product cards in answers?

result.text: How does Brand Concierge use AEM Sites for product cards in answers?
sections: Our approach

Brand Concierge has a native AEM Sites knowledge source: for AEM Sites as a Cloud Service with Content AI enabled, the concierge answers from an existing Content AI index, and Content AI Search is among the integrations Adobe recommends for the Site Advisory skill.
The concierge answers from the AEM Sites content in the Content AI index, without uploads in Brand Concierge; how current it stays depends on how that index is kept up to date.
What we would do

We will in Cloud Manager, set up the Content AI source on the AEM as a Cloud Service environment (make the existing pages index searchable after checking it holds only public content, or crawl the site with exclusions and a refresh schedule), confirm it is Available with test searches, then build the AEM Sites knowledge source in Composer and attach Content AI Search to the Site Advisory skill.

We will set up the Brand Concierge experience for the agreed banking or insurance products: connect and curate the approved content sources, design the conversations and guardrails for the agreed questions, configure the brand voice and the required disclosures, set up the handoff (live chat, meeting booking or both) routed to your designated team, build, with your reviewers, the golden-answer test set (including the priority discovery questions from the Brand Visibility program) and the refusal and escalation scenarios, complete Adobe's pre-go-live checks, and launch on the agreed pages in stages.
We will build the site from the AEM Project Archetype or a Site Template, with Core Components, editable templates, client-side libraries and the custom components the design needs.
We will assign AEM product profiles in the Admin Console, create the production program and environments in Cloud Manager, set up Git access and the first deployment pipelines.
asks: A Content AI source on the environment in Cloud Manager: an existing AEM index made searchable, or a crawl of the publicly reachable site on a refresh schedule
AEM Administrators product profile on author and publish to create or unlock the source (Cloud Manager access alone is not enough), and API credentials scoped to the environment
Index scoped to content fit for public answers: an existing index made searchable bypasses Oak ACLs, and the concierge answers only from its knowledge sources
sells: AEM Sites as a Cloud Service with Content AI enabled (a modernized environment; Adobe says the Content AI API can show 'License required' otherwise)

questions.input: How does Brand Visibility enrich product detail pages in Adobe Commerce?

result.text: How does Brand Visibility enrich product detail pages in Adobe Commerce?
sections: Our approach

Brand Visibility compares the Commerce catalog with what AI agents can read on each product page, then serves the AI assistants Adobe supports (ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude) the missing details at the CDN through Optimize at Edge. The catalog, and the page shoppers and search engines see, stay unchanged.

The AI assistants Adobe supports (ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude) get the variants, specifications and attributes the catalog already holds, without a change to the storefront or the catalog; shoppers and search engines see the page as published.
What we would do

We will connect the agreed eligible Commerce catalog, create a partner validation sheet for up to 10 catalog attributes, and reconcile them to the AI-visible output on up to 25 product-detail pages. The enrichment is served to AI agents at the edge; the catalog records and the page shoppers see stay unchanged.

We will configure the agreed monitoring portfolio (200 to 1,000 prompts in up to three markets or languages), validate access for up to 10 pilot users, confirm the delivery-network setup and register CDN log forwarding in Brand Visibility and confirm the logs arrive once the log-forwarding job is active in your CDN console, and record one baseline for the agreed prompts and three competitors.

We will using the agreed Optimize at Edge route, check that each selected page sends a Last-Modified header where the opportunity needs one, then deploy approved changes for one supported opportunity type (such as Recover Content Visibility, Add Table of Contents or Add LLM-friendly Summaries) to 20 to 50 URLs chosen with the High Potential URLs filter, in one deployment; verify rollback; keep those pages unchanged during the measurement period; and run two operator sessions. Review the Impact Measurement Engine's analysis with you if Adobe generates one.

We will confirm how the store serves pages to AI agents and search engines and which CDN sits closest to visitors, since routing goes on that outer CDN. Prepare and test the Optimize at Edge routing rules for that CDN (Adobe's guides cover Fastly, Akamai, Cloudflare, CloudFront, Azure Front Door and Apache) and have your CDN team, or we with delegated access, apply them in the agreed change window; allow Adobe's edge-optimization user agent through robots.txt and any firewall or bot-manager rules, keep the cache for AI agents separate, test failover to the origin and rollback, and verify one page before the first optimization goes live through the route.
asks: Optimize at Edge routing on the store's outer CDN: Adobe documents one-click setup only for AEM Cloud Service managed Fastly, so Commerce stores, including stores on Fastly, need the IT or CDN team
Brand Visibility connected to Adobe Commerce through the in-product connection setup; Adobe does not document what it needs or which Commerce setups qualify, so confirm
AdobeEdgeOptimize/1.0 and Spacecat/1.0 allowed in robots.txt and applicable WAF or bot rules, with Adobe's current scanner IP addresses and CIDR ranges allowed by CDN or firewall access controls
CDN log forwarding for the store, so product pages can be ranked by agentic traffic
sells: Adobe Commerce storefront and a Brand Visibility license (trials get one opportunity, Recover Content Visibility by default)
